white_space: No competitor currently combines inventory awareness with automated weekly dinner planning (C:FridgeChef, C:PantryGenie, C:ZeroWaste Kitchen handle inventory or waste without full weekly plans, while C:MealLoop, C:PlanPlate, C:WeekWise, and C:SupperSync handle weekly plans without tracking what is already in the fridge or pantry).
pricing_anchors: Competitor pricing ranges from EUR 2.99/month (C:PlanPlate) to EUR 6.99/month (C:MealLoop), with an annual option of EUR 49.99/year (C:MealLoop) and a median stated willingness to pay of EUR 3.50 per month (S05).

idea_claim_checks.claim: Existing recipe apps give ideas but do not know what you already own.
idea_claim_checks.explanation: Competitor rows show that existing apps like FridgeChef and PantryGenie do know what users own through photo recognition and inventory tracking.

idea_claim_checks.claim: Dinner planning is a daily chore, groceries are expensive, and a lot of food gets thrown away.
idea_claim_checks.explanation: Backed by market evidence showing adults spend 22 minutes deciding what to cook (S04), weekly grocery spends average EUR 118 (S02), and households discard 19% of bought food (S01).
